evidence.reason: The test still mutates the shared source manifest through `broken["partial-inspect"]["source"]`. Since phase dictionaries are built from the same `self.source` object and `deepcopy` preserves that aliasing, this assignment changes the prepare/other phase manifests as well. The assertion can therefore be satisfied by a source-manifest failure outside `partial-inspect`, so it does not prove the final inspect manifest is checked. Replacing only `partial-inspect`'s `source` with a copied/modified dict isolates the intended case.
